philosophy.objective: Build a repeatable research habit and improve decision quality; short-term benchmark outperformance is not the goal.
principles: The investor selects every holding and approves every trade.
Primary company and exchange evidence outranks news, market commentary and model opinion.
Price movement and technical signals are context; they cannot by themselves strengthen or break a business thesis.
Missing evidence must remain an explicit unknown and must never be filled with an assumption.
Doing nothing is a valid outcome. Activity is not evidence of good portfolio management.
Every material conclusion should name an observable condition that can confirm or falsify it.
Judge the research process separately from the portfolio return.

SKYGOLD.title: Cash-flow inflection
SKYGOLD.coreThesis: Sky Gold can change from working-capital-hungry growth into self-sustaining compounding as the advance-gold model improves working capital and operating cash flow turns sustainably positive.
mustHappen: FY27 operating cash flow moves materially toward management’s stated positive ₹180–225 crore range.
The working-capital cycle improves as the advance-gold model scales across customers.
Debt and interest burden fall, including execution of the stated land-sale and debt-reduction plan.
supportingFactors: Scale, design breadth and relationships with large organised jewellery retailers support continued demand.
Exports and diamonds are optionality, not requirements for the core thesis.
falsifiers: Operating cash flow remains materially negative without a credible temporary explanation.
Working-capital days deteriorate or customers resist the advance-gold model.
Debt or interest costs rise despite the promised cash-flow and asset-sale plan.
A major customer loss or promoter-related acquisition materially damages economics or minority-shareholder interests.

ANTHEM.title: Restocking recovery and CRDMO capacity ramp
ANTHEM.horizon: FY27–FY29, reviewed at each result and material capacity update
ANTHEM.coreThesis: The FY26 slowdown was substantially a temporary customer-destocking cycle; recovery, differentiated fermentation capabilities and new capacity should restore durable CRDMO growth as molecules progress toward commercialisation.
mustHappen: Subsequent results confirm that customer restocking produces a durable revenue recovery rather than a one-quarter rebound.
Unit III fermentation and other recently added capacity make a measurable contribution through FY27.
The Phase 3 pipeline progresses toward commercial production while Unit IV spending remains economically and financially controlled.
supportingFactors: Integrated discovery-to-commercial CRDMO capabilities and fermentation capacity form the claimed operating moat.
Near-zero leverage and strong historical returns on equity provide capacity-investment resilience.
falsifiers: Revenue fails to recover after the stated end of destocking or management repeatedly resets the explanation.
Material molecule failures, withdrawals or customer losses undermine the commercial pipeline.
Capacity ramps without utilisation, cash returns or credible customer demand.
DavosPharma dependence, an adverse regulatory inspection or scientific-talent loss materially disrupts operations.
Earnings growth fails to support the high valuation over the thesis horizon.
